note: The public version ladder. `version`, `phase` and `mvp` must equal the private roadmap's ladder, row for row (scripts/check-ladder.mjs); `summary` is written for the site and never copied from a private document. States: done, planned, goal, later.

rungs.phase: Phase 0 — Foundation, CI spine & the release path
rungs.summary: The foundation: the plugin loads as CLAP, VST3 and AU and as a standalone app, passes your audio through untouched, asks you to accept its licence, and every quality gate runs.

rungs.phase: Phase 1 — The Joint, the first modules & the docs site
rungs.summary: The Joint: one rack for a whole vocal chain, the first EQ, dynamics and colour modules on rendered hardware, and the take light.
Space: delays, reverbs, doubling, width and the four effect returns, in time with your project.
Tune: pitch correction from classic signal processing, the key found from your vocal, and a low-latency mode for recording.

rungs.phase: Phase 4 — First Light: Drake & the browser
rungs.summary: First light: search an artist and an era, and the whole chain loads in one click. The first complete version.
Input Check, ad-lib chains, your own presets, and undo.
Visual cards: every module shows what it does — the EQ curve over a live spectrum of your vocal, the compressor curve with what it takes — not just knobs.
The first wave of artist chains, a chain for every genre, and the roster page.
In every DAW: saved with your project, automatable, its latency reported, and safe in many instances at once.
The standalone app at full strength, and Takelight on macOS and Linux.
The second wave of artist chains, and a realism and performance pass.
Reference Match: load a reference, and Takelight reads the delays, the reverb, the tone and the rest of its vocal, and proposes them on its own modules.
Hardened: installers for three systems, the update check, the trial and the licence, and the full manual. Still no downloads on this site.
The release candidate: every file reviewed and every host tested by hand.
The release: the free trial, the one-time licence, and the first downloads this site has ever offered.
Vocal Match: your vocal's tone set against a reference you own.
Doubles and harmonies, stacked for you.
A third wave of artist chains, and chains sent in by producers.
Bridges to Freally MIDI Master and Freally Unloop.
Pro Tools as a plugin (AAX), if Avid's terms allow it.
